<p class="x_MsoNormal" data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36);">No external lighting shall be installed on the development hereby permitted unless full details of a lighting scheme are submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall include details of the exact location, height, design, and intensity of the lights, and shall be designed to prevent light spillage onto nearby habitat suitable for bats. The lighting shall be installed and operated strictly in accordance with the approved details.</p><p class="x_MsoNormal" aria-hidden="true" style="margin: 0cm; font-size: 12pt; font-family: Aptos, sans-serif; color: rgb(36, 36, 36);">&nbsp;</p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p><!--StartFragment--><span data-olk-copy-source="MessageBody">Prior to the commencement of construction, a scale, colour plan of biodiversity enhancements on the site, to include the number, specification, and location of enhancements such as bat boxes, bird boxes, hibernacula for herptiles, insect hotels, and hedgehog highways if appropriate, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Thereafter, the biodiversity enhancement measures shall be carried out and retained in accordance with the approved details.</span><!--EndFragment--></p>
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
